# PROCESAMIENTO Y CODIFICACIÓN
### 1. Limpieza del texto y metadatos
```{python}
lemmatizer = WordNetLemmatizer()
stop_words = set(stopwords.words('spanish'))  # usar idioma según contenido

def limpiar_texto(text):
    text = str(text).lower()
    text = re.sub(r"http\S+|www\S+|https\S+", '', text)       # eliminar URLs
    text = re.sub(r'@\w+|#\w+', '', text)                     # eliminar menciones y hashtags
    text = text.translate(str.maketrans('', '', string.punctuation))  # eliminar puntuación
    tokens = nltk.word_tokenize(text)
    tokens = [lemmatizer.lemmatize(word) for word in tokens if word not in stop_words and word.isalpha()]
    return ' '.join(tokens)

df['texto_limpio'] = df['content'].apply(limpiar_texto)
```

```{python}
# Identificar tipos de variables
target = 'toxicity_score'
text_col = 'texto_limpio'
cat_cols = df.select_dtypes(include='object').drop(columns=['texto', text_col], errors='ignore').columns.tolist()
num_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=np.number).drop(columns=[target], errors='ignore').columns.tolist()

print(f"Variables categóricas: {cat_cols}")
print(f"Variables numéricas: {num_cols}")
print(f"Variable de texto: {text_col}")
```

### 2. Definir transformadores TF-IDF por tipo de variable
#### preparacion de columnas de texto para el ML
```{python}
text_transformer = Pipeline(steps=[
    ('tfidf', TfidfVectorizer(max_features=2000, ngram_range=(1,2))),
    # Reduce dimensionality of TF-IDF to obtain a dense, lower-dimensional representation
    ('svd', TruncatedSVD(n_components=100, random_state=42))
])

# Categorización de variables OneHotEncoder
cat_transformer = Pipeline(steps=[
    # Return dense output so downstream resamplers (SMOTE) can operate
    ('onehot', OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore', sparse_output=False))
])

# Escalamiento de variables numéricas
num_transformer = Pipeline(steps=[
    ('scaler', StandardScaler())
])
```

### Combinar transformadores para la nueva database en un ColumnTransformer para modelacións
```{python}
preprocessor = ColumnTransformer(transformers=[
    ('text', text_transformer, text_col),
    ('cat', cat_transformer, cat_cols),
    ('num', num_transformer, num_cols)
])

# Crear pipeline completo (solo preprocesamiento)
preprocessing_pipeline = Pipeline(steps=[
    ('preprocessor', preprocessor)
])
```


```{python}
# Aplicar pipeline de preprocesamiento
print("\nEjecutando preprocesamiento...")
# --- Avoid data leakage: split *before* fitting vectorizers / scalers
# Create binary target for classification (threshold can be adjusted)
umbral = 0.5
df['toxicity_class'] = df['toxicity_score'].apply(lambda x: 1 if x >= umbral else 0)

# Prepare feature dataframe (drop target columns)
X_df = df.drop(columns=[target, 'toxicity_class'], errors='ignore')
y = df['toxicity_class'].values

# Split raw dataframes (preprocessing is fit only on training data)
X_train_df, X_test_df, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X_df, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y)

# Fit preprocessors on training data and transform both train and test
X_train = preprocessing_pipeline.fit_transform(X_train_df)
X_test = preprocessing_pipeline.transform(X_test_df)

print("✅ Preprocesamiento completado.")
print("Dimensiones X_train:", getattr(X_train, 'shape', None))
print("Dimensiones X_test:", getattr(X_test, 'shape', None))
print("Dimensiones de y_train:", getattr(y_train, 'shape', None))
```

# CLASIFICACION SUPERVISADA (RF)
### 1. Nuevamente stadísticas de toxicity_score
```{python}
print("\n=== Estadísticas de toxicity_score ===")
print(df['toxicity_score'].describe())

plt.figure()
sns.histplot(df['toxicity_score'], bins=20, kde=True)
plt.title("Distribución de toxicity_score")
plt.xlabel("Toxicity Score")
plt.ylabel("Frecuencia")
plt.show()
```

### 2. Definición umbrales
Definir variable categórica
Ejemplo simple: binaria
0 = No tóxico (toxicity_score < 0.5)
1 = Tóxico (toxicity_score >= 0.5)
Se puede ajustar a multiclase si se desea
```{python}
# The binary target (`toxicity_class`) was created earlier during preprocessing.
# We already split the raw dataframe and applied preprocessing to obtain
# `X_train`, `X_test`, `y_train`, `y_test`.

print("\nDistribución de clases:")
print(df['toxicity_class'].value_counts())

# At this point we will use the precomputed `X_train`, `X_test`, `y_train`, `y_test`
# produced in the preprocessing step above. Avoid re-splitting or reusing
# variables that are no longer defined (e.g., `X`).
```

### 3. División del dataset en entrenamiento y prueba
```{python}
# The dataset has already been split earlier (before preprocessing) into
# `X_train`, `X_test`, `y_train`, `y_test`. Do not re-split here to avoid
# overwriting those arrays or causing NameError for `X_raw`/`y_raw`.
```

### 4. Balanceo de clases con SMOTE
```{python}
smote = SMOTE(random_state=42)
X_train_bal, y_train_bal = smote.fit_resample(X_train, y_train)

print("\nDistribución después de SMOTE:")
print(pd.Series(y_train_bal).value_counts())
```

### 5. Entrenamiento del modelo Random Forest
```{python}
rf_clf = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=200, random_state=42)
rf_clf.fit(X_train_bal, y_train_bal)
```

### 6. Predicción
```{python}
y_pred = rf_clf.predict(X_test)
y_proba = rf_clf.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1]  # probabilidades para ROC
```

### 7. Evaluación del modelo
```{python}
acc = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)
prec = precision_score(y_test, y_pred)
rec = recall_score(y_test, y_pred)
f1 = f1_score(y_test, y_pred)
roc_auc = roc_auc_score(y_test, y_proba)
print("\n=== Métricas de evaluación ===")
print(f"Accuracy:  {acc:.3f}")
print(f"Precision: {prec:.3f}")
print(f"Recall:    {rec:.3f}")
print(f"F1 Score:  {f1:.3f}")
print(f"ROC-AUC:   {roc_auc:.3f}")
```
```{python}
cm = confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred)
disp = ConfusionMatrixDisplay(confusion_matrix=cm, display_labels=['No Tóxico','Tóxico'])
disp.plot(cmap=plt.cm.Blues)
plt.title("Matriz de Confusión - Random Forest")
plt.show()
```

```{python}
RocCurveDisplay.from_estimator(rf_clf, X_test, y_test)

plt.show()
```
